reuse.why: Builds on recurConfigToRSchedule, RSchedule and the shared applyWeekendRule, the same pieces getUpcomingDates and the date helpers use, instead of re-implementing recurrence or weekend handling.

duplication.why: Only the two-line config-to-RSchedule setup is repeated from getUpcomingDates; the weekend rule is shared.

placement.why: Handler sits beside getUpcomingDates in server/schedules/app.ts and is registered in SchedulesHandlers like its siblings.

scope.why: Only the new handler, its registration and tests.

maintainability.why: Clear and small with a named constant for the window padding; that constant silently encodes applyWeekendRule's maximum shift and lacks the captureBreadcrumb error handling of getUpcomingDates.
